name: Forge
description: A bold, dark, award-style marketing site LOOK for a creative / brand & web studio — a warm near-black canvas with an acid-green accent, a recreated case-study showcase, a scrolling client + awards marquee, a 2-up work gallery, a 4-up stat band, numbered services, a process timeline, and testimonials, plus Work, Services, About, an Insights index, Careers, a Contact form, an article template, and brand-voiced welcome + studio-notes emails. The look, not the content: it ships no articles of its own, so the Insights index fills with your own posts (or industry sample data) and is empty until then. Near-monochrome dark apex theme with a single acid accent. Installs as a draft for the tenant to review, customize, and publish.
